name: Microgrid transition-state indication
summary: Reports that the controller is between its defined stable operating modes.
description: Reports that the controller is between its defined stable operating modes. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Mode-transition logic” at the input and “Transition-in-progress indication” at the output. Intermediate states need explicit interpretation.
